Definition: another form for G2293; to exercise courage:--be bold, X boldly, have confidence, be confident. Compare G5111.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tharrhéō is the word for to have courage, to be bold. In 2 Corinthians 5:6, Therefore we are always confident, and it appears again in Hebrews 13:6. In the Greek text the word is spelled θαρρέω.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe courage is not the absence of fear but the decision to stand because God is with me.
